items.sentence: An instructor will simplify the long rules for everyone.
Voters choose a committee, while citizens speak directly at meetings.
One guide will accompany the class into the cave.
The table shows water increasing in direct proportion to cups.
Every household on the street shared garden tools cheerfully.
Today, the absence of wind made the lake perfectly still.
Before winter, the primary goal was finishing the treehouse.
Today, can you spot the poison dart frog among the leaves?
Kindly do not bother the bees close to the flowers.
One river forms the border between two green countries.
